document.title: Afghanistan: Taliban Agree to Visits of Militant Training Camps, Admit Bin Ladin is Their Guest (1997 Peshaw 00021)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Taliban Biography: The Structure and Leadership of the Taliban 1996-2002
document.note: [Secret] Taliban Foreign Minister Ghaus and Mullah Rabbani tell U.S. officials to choose a delegation and dates to visit camps the Taliban claim to have closed. Deputy FM Jalil says bin Laden had lived in caves near Tora Bora and was told to move to an ordinary house.

persons.name: Mullah Mohammad Rabbani
persons.role: Senior Taliban leader; chairman of the interim caretaker government/interim Shura in Kabul, then sitting in Kandahar

mentions.quote: SENIOR TALIBAN LEADER MULLAH MOHAMMAD RABBANI AGREED THE USG, THROUGH THE TALIBAN AMBASSADOR IN ISLAMABAD, SHOULD PROPOSE NAMES
RABBANI ACKNOWLEDGED THAT BIN LADIN WAS IN THE JALALABAD AREA, ADDING HE WAS LIVING THERE AS "A GUEST, AS A REFUGEE."

persons.name: Mullah Mohammad Hassan
persons.role: Kandahar governor and acting head of the interim Shura in Kabul

mentions.quote: MULLAH MOHAMMAD HASSAN (ACTING HEAD OF THE INTERIM SHURA IN KABUL) ACKNOWLEDGED THAT USAMA BIN LADIN IS THEIR "GUEST,"
THE TALIBAN CANNOT EXPEL THEM ... BECAUSE THEY ARE STRANGERS AND AS MUSLIMS, THEY CAN LIVE IN THIS COUNTRY.
FOLLOW UP ACTING FM MULLAH GHAUS' OFFER TO VISIT MILITANT TRAINING CAMPS
DEPUTY FM ABDUL JALIL REPLIED SIMILARLY, STATING THAT THE TALIBAN DID NOT ESTABLISH THESE TRAINING CAMPS.
BIN LADIN HAD LIVED IN CAVES SOUTH OF JALALABAD IN TORA BORA AND THE TALIBAN HAD BECOME SUSPICIOUS.
DCM ALSO INFORMED DEPUTY FM STANAKZATI AND MULLAH MOHAMMAD HASSAN

persons.name: Usama bin Ladin
persons.role: Militant financier/terror suspect living as Taliban 'guest' near Jalalabad

mentions.quote: USAMA BIN LADIN IS THEIR "GUEST," ADDING THAT HE HAS BEEN ASKED NOT TO CARRY OUT TERRORIST ACTIVITIES
REPORTING IN OTHER CHANNELS SUGGESTS BIN LADIN IS PAYING OFF SOME INDIVIDUAL TALIBAN.

persons.role: Controlled Nangarhar province before Taliban takeover

mentions.quote: BIN LADIN CAME TO AFGHANISTAN WHEN HAJI QADIR CONTROLLED NANGARHAR PROVINCE.

events.description: DCM Islamabad met senior Taliban in Kandahar, accepted offer to visit camps.
DCM pressed Rabbani on Bin Ladin's presence; Taliban admit he is a guest.
DCM met Mullah Hassan and Stanakzai in Kabul.
Cable sent by Consulate Peshawar reporting meetings.
DCM Islamabad met Rabbani in Kandahar; agreed on US proposal of delegation names/dates for camp visits; bin Ladin raised.
DCM met senior Taliban leaders including Hassan and Jalil, accepting Ghaus' offer to visit camps.
DCM met Stanakzai and Mullah Hassan in Kabul and briefed them on the arrangement; Hassan said Taliban cannot expel bin Ladin.
US Consulate Peshawar cable reporting the meetings.
Planned week of US Embassy Islamabad approach to Taliban ambassador about camp visits.

key_claims: Taliban leaders Rabbani and Hassan publicly acknowledged Bin Ladin as a 'guest' and refugee near Jalalabad.
Taliban claim training camps are closed and agreed in principle to US visits.
Taliban say Bin Ladin promised not to carry out terrorism and was told to leave Tora Bora caves for an ordinary house.
Taliban deny responsibility for pre-Taliban acts and say camps date from the anti-Soviet jihad.
US consulate assesses Taliban concluded it was in their interest to shelter Bin Ladin, who may be paying some Taliban.
